title: Canonical adjoint continuous-ring comparison
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] in universe $u$ and $T$ a topological ring in universe $u$. Write $\underline T(S)=C(S,T)$ for its condensed ring [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring] and $R_{T,X}=p_X^*\underline T$ for its pulled-back ring object [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Let $F_{T,X}$ be the ring sheaf $U\mapsto C(|U|,T)$, with pointwise operations and precomposition on the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category]; sections are lifted to universe $u+1$. For a profinite set $S$, the test scheme $X[S]$ of [def-sfb-profinite-test-objects] has the canonical projection $\pi_S:|X[S]|\to S$ induced by the evaluation of locally constant integer functions. Define the adjoint comparison $\underline T\to p_{X*}F_{T,X}$ by $f\mapsto f\circ\pi_S$ on each $S$. Define $\operatorname{comparison}_{X,T}:R_{T,X}\to F_{T,X}$ to be its transpose under the point inverse-image adjunction. This is a morphism of ring objects: it preserves multiplication and unit. The construction assumes neither total disconnectedness nor a field structure, and does not assert invertibility.

def comparison (X : Scheme.{u}) (E : Type u)
    [TopologicalSpace E] [Ring E] [IsTopologicalRing E] :
    condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObjOfUniverse E) X ⟶
      ((sheafCompose (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
        (forget₂ RingCat.{u + 1} AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj
          (continuousCoefficientRingSheaf X E))
